novelty_flags.label: GhoshDebKarmakarSen2026RankEstimator comparison
novelty_flags.one_line: The core says its Theorem 2.3 gives local rank asymptotics under pair-spacing, but the cited arXiv paper’s Theorem 2.3 is consistent estimation of its asymptotic variance quantity, not the claimed result.

soundness_flags.label: ass:pair-spacing
soundness_flags.one_line: The condition is tagged as a standard variant of Assumption 3 in Ghosh et al., but that cited source does not support the claimed pair-spacing attribution; retag it novel with a source-independent justification or replace the citation.

soundness_flags.label: dref / thm:uniform-selected-transfer
soundness_flags.one_line: The random reference distance omits its holdout argument while taking a supremum over rho: one realized dataset and Fisher reference at a fixed rho cannot define references for all rho without an explicit joint coupling or a rho-indexed probability statement.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:uniform-selected-transfer
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The transfer is conditional on each fixed admissible baseline array and uses an array-dependent remainder, with no deterministic rate uniform over the qualitative class.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Uniformity is only over rho, theta, and h for each fixed B in the stated class.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:exact-selective-level
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Finite-sample exactness is limited to the prespecified Fisher sharp-zero null; positive alternatives use a distinct sampling law and a null completion only for rerandomization.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Exact level is asserted only under h=0, while positive-h conclusions are asymptotic conditional-power statements.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:tolerance-certificate
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The certificate reports optimizer sets and may assert uniqueness only after a supplied separation certificate.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The computational conclusion is set-valued absent a verified separation certificate.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Sections 1.1 and 5, especially paragraphs beginning at the hold-out discussion and lines 573-580 of the journal HTML
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article derives selectively valid randomization p-values for adaptive experiments and explicitly identifies choice of hold-out units and powerful selection-dependent test statistics as future design questions.

The paper optimizes discretized two-stage enrichment decision and multiple-testing rules by sparse linear programming, minimizing expected sample size subject to power and familywise-error constraints.

The paper studies conditional inference in batched bandit experiments, identifies last-batch optimality absent restrictions, and identifies one additional statistic under location invariance.
